title: Interlock policy: Semantic contract matrix and automated upgrade validators
creator: Amina Patel
description: Problem: As we maintain multiple LTS channels across runtime, API, SDKs, and console, we lack a single machine-readable contract describing cross-surface compatibility constraints, and we lack automated validators to gate upgrades. This causes manual, error-prone rollouts, late-stage incompatibility discoveries (especially between SDKs and runtime protocol changes), and conservative delays for customer upgrades. Goal: Define a semantic contract matrix (SCM) that maps supported compatibility surfaces (runtime <-> API <-> SDK <-> console) for each channel and minor version, embed it in release artifacts, and implement automated validators that run as part of release CI and the console's rollout gating. The SCM should be human-readable and machine-parsable (YAML/JSON), enable preflight checks (API schema, wire protocol, config knobs), and drive an upgrade decision engine that recommends rollout gates, canary cohorts, and rollback heuristics. This ticket covers the design, validation automation, and a minimal implementation that wires SCM checks into the runtime release pipeline and console rollout hooks.
acceptance_criteria: A documented semantic contract matrix exists covering runtime, REST/gRPC API, public SDKs, and console UI behaviors for LTS channels and two latest minor versions.
A CI validator tool ingests the SCM and performs automated checks: API schema compatibility, runtime protocol handshake tests, and SDK smoke tests; failures block the channel promotion pipeline.
Console rollout flow consumes SCM to compute safe canary cohorts and exposes an explicit incompatibility warning when attempting rollouts that violate contracts.
Rollback heuristics are defined and codified: conditions for immediate rollback, automated rollback triggers (error budget breach, latency regression), and manual rollback playbook link.
At least one internal release (runtime-1.20 candidate) exercises SCM checks end-to-end with a staged canary and explicit validation logs stored in release artifacts.
Release notes include a machine-readable SCM artifact and human summary for customers and SDK maintainers.
tasks: Draft SCM schema (fields: channel, minor_version, supported_api_versions, wire_protocol_flags, deprecated_endpoints, expected_kv_cache_behavior, sdk_semver_policy, console_feature_flags).
Prototype CI validator that runs: openapi diff for API, protocol handshake tests against runtime canary, and a smoke SDK run that executes sample CRUD + streaming flows.
Add SCM publishing step to release pipeline: attach SCM.json to release tag and notify console rollout service.
Integrate SCM checks into console rollout UI: surface compatibility score and explicit gating decision with required approvals.
Define rollback heuristics and implement an automated rollback trigger that can be enabled per-release channel.
Create migration guidance for SDK authors and a checklist for product/solutions teams before scheduling upgrades.
Run tabletop with SRE, SDK owners, and Console PM to validate playbooks and thresholds.
notes: Design rationale: machine-parsable SCM reduces manual matrix spreadsheets and enables programmatic gating; tradeoffs include schema drift management and the complexity of verifying behavioral contracts vs. syntactic ones.

Reference artifacts: https://confluence.redwood.ai/release/scm-proposal (proto), https://github.com/redwood-inference/release-tools/pull/412 (ci validator prototype), https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/2013 (ui gating stub).

Key decisions pending: degree of strictness for SDK semver policy (allow major bumps vs force-major coordination), whether to block GA promotions for flaky system tests, and how to encode opt-in experimental console features in SCM.
Operational note: validators will emit a structured report consumed by the release dashboard; retention policy TBD (suggest 90 days).
Risk: false positives in behavioral tests could slow releases; mitigation includes a quarantine channel and manual override with audit log.
